Quick Demo:
📂 Assignment:

📈 Interactive Function & Conic Grapher

High-precision Cartesian coordinate plotter for parabolas, rational functions with asymptotes & holes, polynomials, exponentials, logarithms, circles, ellipses, hyperbolas, and inequalities.

Course Presets:

➗ Synthetic Division & Remainder / Factor Theorem (Ch 3.3)

Enter polynomial coefficients in descending order (space-separated, e.g. "2 -11 13 -7 12") and divisor root c to see the tableau, quotient, remainder, factor verdict, and polynomial graph.

🎯 Polynomial Zeros, Multiplicities, Rational Zero Theorem & Graph (Ch 3.3–3.4)

Enter any polynomial expression (e.g. "x^3 + x^2 - 36x - 36" or "3x^4 - 7x^3 - 6x^2 + 12x + 8" or "-2(x-1)^2(x+2)") or space-separated coefficients. Finds all Rational Zero Theorem p/q candidates, exact zeros, multiplicities (crosses vs touches/turns), end behavior, and plots the curve.

📉 Rational Function Analyzer: Holes, Vertical/Horizontal/Slant Asymptotes & Graph (Ch 3.5)

Enter the Numerator P(x) and Denominator Q(x) of f(x) = P(x)/Q(x). Automatically detects removable holes, vertical asymptotes, horizontal or oblique (slant) asymptotes, domain, x/y-intercepts, and plots all branches.

⚖️ Polynomial & Rational Inequality Sign Chart Solver (Ch 3.6)

Enter any polynomial or rational inequality (e.g. "x^3 - 3x - 2 < 0", "(x - 2)/(x + 3) > 1", "(3x - 1)/(3x + 3) < 6", "x^2 - 6x > 27"). Moves all terms to LHS, finds boundary zeros and undefined points, builds the full interval Sign Chart, and plots the solution.

🚀 Exponential, Logarithmic & Inverse Function / Equation Solver (Ch 4.1–4.6)

Analyze and graph exponential functions f(x) = a·b^(x - h) + k, logarithmic functions f(x) = a·log_b(x - h) + k, solve exponential/log equations, or compute compound interest & continuous growth.

🪐 Conic Sections: Ellipses & Hyperbolas Analyzer & Plotter (Ch 10.2–10.3)

Computes center (h, k), vertices, co-vertices, foci c, fundamental box, asymptote equations, domain, range, and renders the full conic graph.

🔗 Systems of Equations: 2×2 Linear & Nonlinear Parabola/Circle-Line (Ch 9.1 & 9.5)

Enter two equations separated by a comma (e.g. "2x + 3y = 7, x - y = 1" or "y = x^2 - 4, y = 2x - 1" or "x^2 + y^2 = 25, y = x + 1"). Solves for all real intersection points (x, y) and graphs both curves.

📈 Quadratic Functions & Parabola Explorer (Ch 3.1)

Supports both Standard Form f(x) = ax² + bx + c and Vertex Form a(x - h)² + k. Calculates vertex, axis, min/max, vertex form, intercepts, domain, range, and live parabola graph.

🎯 Quadratic Equation Solver: ax² + bx + c = 0 (Ch 1.4)

Solves any quadratic equation using the quadratic formula with discriminant analysis, exact simplified radical form, complex conjugate roots, and parabola root plot.

📏 Absolute Value: |ax + b| [op] c (Ch 1.6 & 1.8)

Solves absolute value inequalities and equations, properly handling positive, zero, and negative right-hand bounds with conjunctions, disjunctions, and number-line plot.

⭕ Circle Analyzer: General Form, Standard Form & Endpoints (Ch 1.1)

Completes the square from General Form Ax² + Ay² + Bx + Cy + D = 0 into Standard Form (x - h)² + (y - k)² = r², finding Center, Radius, Domain, Range, Cardinal Points, and Circle Graph.

🌿 Radical Simplifier & Square Root Property

Simplifies radicals √N or √(-N) into greatest square factor and real or imaginary unit i. Also solves x² = N.

🔢 Complex Numbers: Multiplication, Division, Classification & Powers of i (Ch 1.3)

Performs FOIL multiplication, conjugate division, and classifies numbers in standard form a + bi.

🚀 Projectile Motion & Optimization: h(t) = -16t² + v₀t + h₀ (Ch 3.1)

Analyzes vertical motion under gravity to calculate maximum height, time to reach vertex, total flight time before landing, and trajectory graph.

🧮 Distance & Midpoint Formula Between (x₁, y₁) and (x₂, y₂) (Ch 1.1)

Calculates exact distance (simplified radical and decimal) and coordinates of the midpoint between two Cartesian points.

⚡ Universal Polynomial Evaluator & Factor Test

Evaluate any polynomial P(x) at x = x₀ using Horner's method / Synthetic division.
